title: Linkaround — Web Master / Web Designer / external WordPress collaboration
fit_reasons: Official careers page explicitly allows either full-time employment or an external collaboration
The role centers on WordPress plugin development, PHP, JavaScript, jQuery, CSS and MySQL
The webmaster profile combines development with visual sensitivity, matching VDS web production and UX implementation positioning
The official application form supports a one-to-one external-partner proposal without substituting a generic address
material_gaps: The role asks for mastery of mainstream back-end and front-end technologies; depth must be documented without overstating it
Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma and Canva are listed; only tools actually used by Giuseppe should be claimed
Remote work from Spain, workload, rates and engagement duration are not published
The form asks for year of birth, which is personal data and should be supplied only if Giuseppe chooses to apply
next_action: Apply manually as an external WordPress/frontend and maintenance partner, linking relevant work and asking whether remote collaboration from Spain is accepted.
notes: Fit score is an assessment, not a win probability. The official form is preserved; no generic company email was substituted.
